status: research_only. Vectors of two kinds. (a) Rule-fires vectors assert that the encoded rule reproduces the stated outcome of its sutra. (b) Worked-example vectors reproduce Abhyankar's own fourteen karaka-kundalis from Introduction paragraphs 114-129, read off the page images. Their results are published pass AND fail: seven of the eight charts that print degrees reproduce Abhyankar's stated Atmakaraka under the highest-degree-within-sign rule, and one -- Nehru -- does not, under any Rahu convention.
